persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Draw exactly three red balloons floating against a pale blue sky, each with its own dangling string. Keep them apart so I can count them. Square image, no text.
bank.Arrangement: Separated so all three are easy to count, each with its own dangling string.

messages.text: Could you draw some balloons for me, floating against a pale blue sky? I’ve had a simple balloon picture in mind for a while and would really like to see it made. There should be exactly three balloons, all red, and the image should be square with no text. Each balloon needs its own dangling string. Please keep the balloons apart so I can count them easily.
